title: Gateway Arch National Park Designation Act
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The expanded summary of the Senate passed version is repeated here.)

Gateway Arch National Park Designation Act

(Sec. 2) This bill designates the Jefferson National Expansion Memorial in Missouri as the "Gateway Arch National Park."

summary.headline: This law renames the Jefferson National Expansion Memorial in Missouri as the Gateway Arch National Park.
summary.what_it_does: The bill gives the Jefferson National Expansion Memorial in Missouri a new name, Gateway Arch National Park. The summary does not describe any new funding, rules, or changes to how the site is run. It took effect when it was signed into law on February 22, 2018.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: February 22, 2018, the date it was enacted.
